claim: The corpus is fundamentally a non-raster state/event ontology.
evidence: Latest synthesis explicitly recasts cones, SDF zero, parity, double vacuum and hourglass as operators in a shared state space.
scientific_verdict: Coherent as a software architecture concept.
required_test: Implement a restricted relation family with state_at and next_event queries.

claim: All world structure should be represented globally in spherical coordinates.
source_location: Earlier corpus motifs; corrected in Chronological pp.1,6
evidence: Mature documents state spherical/polar structure is local support and sensing, not total world replacement.
scientific_verdict: No general advantage; coordinate singularities and topology matter.
required_test: Compare hybrid local charts against global coordinate models.

claim: A fixed closed expression can be evaluated at a distant time without replaying every frame.
evidence: Horizon independence is defined narrowly for fixed expressions.
scientific_verdict: Possible for analytically solvable or compiled dynamics.
required_test: Measure query cost versus skipped horizon and expression depth.

claim: The architecture has universal O(1) complexity.
source_location: Hollowland pp.15,26-33; corrected in Chronological p.8
evidence: Later source explicitly rejects universal constant cost.
scientific_verdict: False in general due root solving, branching, event density and expression growth.
required_test: Complexity analysis and adversarial event-density benchmarks.

claim: The architecture uses zero memory.
source_location: Hollowland pp.15,26-33; corrected in Chronological pp.1,8
evidence: Later source acknowledges seed, grammar, exogenous log and lineage storage.
scientific_verdict: False literally.
required_test: Measure total memory including coefficients, logs, branches, calibration and solver workspace.

claim: Double vacuum is a second physical vacuum.
source_location: Hollowland pp.1-10; corrected in Chronological p.6
evidence: Mature definition is absence of coupling between co-located sectors.
scientific_verdict: Useful state-partition abstraction, not a new vacuum state.
required_test: Demonstrate gated co-location in a formal model or isolated optical modes.

claim: A Klein bottle supplies a global signed distance field with automatic sign flipping.
evidence: Non-orientability makes a global inside/outside sign nontrivial.
scientific_verdict: Requires local charts, orientation double cover or explicit gluing; no automatic bitwise NOT law.
required_test: Specify manifold atlas, transition functions and local SDF convention.

claim: Passing B=0 should invoke transition semantics.
evidence: Latest synthesis explicitly converts zero from a marching target to event surface.
scientific_verdict: Standard hybrid-system pattern.
required_test: Robust root detection with tangency/uncertainty handling.

claim: A one-bit state is sufficient to encode the whole system.
source_location: Earlier corpus; corrected in Spherical Throughput pp.2,7
evidence: Later source limits bit to route/validity/parity; amplitudes, thresholds, uncertainty and lineage are separate.
scientific_verdict: False for nontrivial physical/biological systems.
required_test: Define bit schema and full surrounding state.

claim: Golden-ratio phase prevents loops and stabilizes the system.
evidence: The sources conflate φ phase with Φ golden ratio.
scientific_verdict: Irrational rotations can reduce exact periodic recurrence in ideal arithmetic, but do not prevent numerical loops or instability generally.
required_test: Prove recurrence/conditioning properties for specified dynamics and finite precision.

claim: Log-polar coordinates eliminate geometric distortion.
evidence: Log-polar mapping redistributes scale and angle but is not globally isometric.
scientific_verdict: It introduces metric distortion and an origin singularity.
required_test: Quantify inverse error, sampling density and condition number.

claim: The cone-SDF intersection is always solvable in one operation.
evidence: Only simple relation families have closed-form roots.
scientific_verdict: General nonlinear systems require numerical or certified root-finding and may have multiple roots.
required_test: Specify relation family and solver guarantees.

claim: The practical optical architecture is Maxwell + fluid interface + coupled modes + event logic.
evidence: The later integration explicitly separates governing physics by type.
scientific_verdict: Technically coherent modeling stack.
required_test: Calibrated multiphysics model and matched electronic baseline.

claim: Liquid overclad on a solid waveguide is the best first prototype.
evidence: Source compares liquid overclad, liquid core and input liquid lens.
scientific_verdict: Plausible due packaging/control simplicity relative to liquid core.
required_test: Fabricate and measure loss, phase range, settling and hysteresis.

claim: Hollowlens-0 already outperforms electronics.
evidence: Source labels component feasibility as not system validation.
scientific_verdict: Unknown.
required_test: Verified events/s and events/J at equal error/uncertainty, including all support hardware.

claim: Optical propagation means zero latency.
source_location: ADDominUS pp.18-24; rejected in Spherical Throughput p.10
evidence: Later source includes coupling, actuation, detection, conversion and control.
scientific_verdict: End-to-end latency is nonzero.
required_test: Measure median and tail latency including liquid settling and electronics.

claim: Photonics means zero heat or zero power.
source_location: ADDominUS pp.18-24; rejected in Spherical Throughput p.10
evidence: Lasers, modulators, actuators, detectors and control consume energy.
scientific_verdict: Passive photonics may reduce some operations, not total power to zero.
required_test: Wall-plug energy per verified event.

claim: The physical component classes behind Hollowlens-0 exist.
evidence: Source lists liquid lenses, optofluidic MZIs, liquid guides and femtosecond-written glass guides with literature anchors.
scientific_verdict: Yes at component level.
required_test: Integrated system demonstration.

claim: Spherical throughput equals raw photon flux.
evidence: Metric counts only supported, compatible, guard-crossing, confident outputs.
scientific_verdict: Correct to distinguish verified event rate from detector traffic.
required_test: Pre-register gates and error budget.

claim: DMT's molecular structure is encoded in the alchemical prose.
evidence: DMT functions as a metaphor; no bond graph or atom list is encoded.
scientific_verdict: No uniquely recoverable hidden structure.
required_test: None; use standard chemical databases for the molecular graph.

claim: DMT is C12H16N2 with an indole core and tertiary dimethylamine side chain.
evidence: Standard chemical identity.
scientific_verdict: Correct for neutral free base.
required_test: Not applicable; distinguish salts/protonation.

claim: Water/glycerol mixtures can act as tunable liquid optical media.
evidence: Explicit candidate in source; established optofluidic materials concept.
scientific_verdict: Yes, subject to absorption, index, viscosity and packaging.
required_test: Spectral/material characterization.

claim: All fluid atoms are spherical and should be stored in a spherical LUT.
evidence: Source treats individual fluid components as spherical.
scientific_verdict: Hard-sphere/kernels are approximations; real molecules are anisotropic and quantum mechanical.
required_test: Compare approximation error against molecular model.

claim: Reaction-diffusion can generate fronts and patterns.
evidence: Source invokes concentration waves and straight fronts.
scientific_verdict: Correct in appropriate chemical/biological systems.
required_test: Specify reaction kinetics and diffusion coefficients.

claim: Reaction-diffusion explains every straight crystal facet or whisker.
evidence: Source maps straight features to stabilized wave fronts.
scientific_verdict: Crystal facets arise from anisotropic free energies/kinetics; whiskers involve growth and mechanics; reaction-diffusion may contribute but is not universal.
required_test: Material-specific growth model and measurements.

claim: Microsaccades implement a binary search over a slit.
evidence: Source calls eye jitter a one-bit search.
scientific_verdict: Microsaccades are fixational eye movements, not a literal binary-search algorithm.
required_test: Oculomotor experiment and computational model.

claim: Bee vision is simply 300 FPS versus human 60 FPS.
evidence: Source uses display-frame terminology for flicker perception.
scientific_verdict: Temporal resolution varies by species, illumination, receptor and neural processing; 'FPS' is not a universal eye property.
required_test: Species- and condition-specific flicker-fusion measurements.

claim: White light is a packet of discrete color strings.
evidence: Source treats color separation as discrete strings.
scientific_verdict: Light has a spectral distribution; photons have quantized energy, but color is not a set of literal strings.
required_test: Use spectral radiometry and quantum optics terminology.

claim: A log-radius channel offset corrects all chromatic aberration at zero cost.
evidence: Source proposes constant ρ offsets.
scientific_verdict: Can approximate scale-like lateral aberration; cannot correct all wavelength-dependent field aberrations and still costs computation/calibration.
required_test: Lens-specific distortion calibration and image-quality comparison.

claim: Feynman vectors are a defined Kees Klootwijk rendering primitive.
evidence: No formal definition, derivation or implementation is supplied.
scientific_verdict: Closest established structures are complex phasors, wave amplitudes and path integrals.
required_test: Formal semantics, algorithm and reproducible implementation.

claim: 1-bit PDM/delta-sigma can represent continuous tone temporally.
evidence: Source maps amplitude to pulse density.
scientific_verdict: Correct in a bandwidth-limited system with filtering/integration.
required_test: Quantization-noise, flicker and panel-bandwidth measurements.

claim: Log-polar blue-noise screening is useful for radial art/prepress.
evidence: Source proposes radius-dependent stochastic screening.
scientific_verdict: Potentially useful, but not a standard validated prepress method.
required_test: Moiré, dot gain and perceptual print tests against conventional screens.

claim: CRISPR work is merely a 20-character search followed by blind injection.
evidence: Source accurately names guide RNA/Cas9 but dismisses broader laboratory design.
scientific_verdict: Genome editing includes target design, biochemical validation, delivery, repair outcomes and off-target analysis.
required_test: Compare against actual experimental workflow.

claim: A phase/eigenvalue controller can eliminate gene-expression mistakes or cancer.
evidence: No molecular target, intervention, model or evidence.
scientific_verdict: Not established.
required_test: Mechanistic preclinical evidence, safety and clinical validation.

claim: Protein folding can be solved exactly and instantly as a procedural grammar.
evidence: Source offers no sequence-dependent energy model or solver.
scientific_verdict: Protein ensembles are complex and context-dependent; some predictions are tractable, exact dynamics are not generally closed-form.
required_test: Benchmark against experimental structures/dynamics across diverse proteins.

claim: Blood plasma can be therapeutically tethered to an eigenvector axis.
evidence: No physical actuator or clinical mechanism.
scientific_verdict: Flow can be modeled; 'eigenvector tethering' is not a treatment.
required_test: Specify device, forces, biological endpoints and safety.

claim: The spike protein punctures a human cell wall like a mechanical key.
evidence: Human cells lack cell walls; entry mechanisms involve receptors, proteases and membranes.
scientific_verdict: Wrong as stated.
required_test: Use virus-specific cell-entry literature.

claim: Opossum venom resistance implies universal viral immunity or metabolic absolute zero.
evidence: Venom-neutralizing factors are toxin-specific biological chemistry, not universal antiviral state.
scientific_verdict: Not supported.
required_test: Virus-specific immunology and challenge studies.

claim: The Resident Evil T-virus can be decoded into real biochemistry.
evidence: Narrative franchise element.
scientific_verdict: No real molecular structure exists in the source.
required_test: None.

claim: BBMB dynamics justify the document's two-D/φ overlap geometry.
evidence: Search result mentions BBMB, but the prose does not connect its PDE to the overlap by derivation.
scientific_verdict: No established link.
required_test: Derive geometry from a PDE solution and boundary conditions.

claim: Two overlapping arches must be 1:1 to prevent an accretion disk tearing.
evidence: No warped-disk equations or parameters are supplied.
scientific_verdict: No universal ratio.
required_test: Use established warped-disk dynamics with torque, viscosity and boundary conditions.

claim: The slight φ/D overlap can be interpreted as A∩B.
evidence: Source explicitly identifies shared domain/mutual information.
scientific_verdict: Correct as set geometry; other physical meanings require a model.
required_test: Define sets and measure overlap.

claim: Replacing BVHs and octrees with compatibility bits is always faster.
evidence: No workload or asymptotic comparison.
scientific_verdict: Performance depends on sparsity, support selectivity, relation cost and hardware.
required_test: Matched benchmarks across spatial distributions.

claim: 1,000,000 entities fit under 32 MB universally.
evidence: No state layout or accounting is shown.
scientific_verdict: Possible for very compact records, not a universal world-state claim.
required_test: Publish byte-level schema and total allocator/solver memory.

claim: A 64-bit ontological UUID is collision-free identity.
evidence: 64-bit spaces have finite collision probability and lineage data may exceed 64 bits.
scientific_verdict: Useful compact ID, not guaranteed uniqueness without policy.
required_test: Collision analysis, namespace, merge/split and provenance design.

claim: An equation-world can replace all PDE solvers and renderers.
source_location: Earlier grand claims; rejected in Spherical Throughput p.10
evidence: Later report explicitly excludes replacement of all renderers/PDE solvers.
scientific_verdict: No universal replacement.
required_test: Domain-specific benchmark only.

claim: A BCI can retroactively erase or nullify bodily intrusion by phase separation.
evidence: No credible hardware, neurophysiology or causal mechanism.
scientific_verdict: Not a medical or engineering capability.
required_test: Do not treat as factual; any BCI work requires ethical, clinical and regulatory validation.

claim: The document can make a person physically untouchable or invisible.
evidence: Uses vector orthogonality and topology as sovereignty metaphors.
scientific_verdict: No physical mechanism.
required_test: None; interpret as narrative boundary language only.

claim: A country or social system can be physically domain-warped by a global matrix.
evidence: Social/political language is mapped onto geometry.
scientific_verdict: One may model networks/state transitions, but not literally warp a country.
required_test: Define measurable social variables and model validation.

claim: The prototype should be headless/query-first rather than a renderer demo.
evidence: Both mature documents prioritize state/event outputs and pre-registered metrics.
scientific_verdict: Methodologically sound for testing the core claim.
required_test: Build digital transfer model before optical hardware.

claim: Success requires compatibility + event-solving cost to grow more slowly than avoided materialization.
evidence: Explicit core benchmark criterion.
scientific_verdict: Appropriate engineering test.
required_test: Measure both sides under controlled workloads.
